page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 12 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 12 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 24.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It lacks local storage and dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data reveals a performance profile characterized by average multi-core capabilities alongside weaker single-core execution. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is rated in the bottom 25% at 1107.38, and single-threaded gzip compression falls into the bottom 10% at 19.09 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-core operations demonstrate moderate capacity, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 8800.46 and a PassMark CPU score of 10233.84, both placing in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds for large blocks, at 59.6 GB/sec and 50.4 GB/sec respectively, though the PassMark memory score is weak at 1749.38.

The server presents a clear tradeoff between single-threaded execution speed and multi-threaded throughput. While single-core tasks and static web serving are weak, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Redis SET operations perform at average levels. For language model workloads, the hardware handles small 135M models adequately but struggles with larger 7B models, yielding a poor prompt processing speed of 15.22 tokens/sec. Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is suited for moderately threaded compute tasks, basic database operations, and distributed caching workloads that do not require high memory density or local SSD storage.
